next_hypotheses: KLD is not theoretically asymptotic at 0.20: full-MQ6/q8-KV control reached 0.067687, proving the eval can see Q4-class KLD.
Under the current cheap tensor-transplant/MQ4-refit loop, the curve is flattening around 0.205-0.21. cand148 is accepted at 0.206809; cand146 got 0.205683 but failed PPL/speed.
Next work should either harden the L10 branch with a stronger PPL/speed repair or move to a real GPTQ/full-Hessian block objective. Diagonal rotated activation weighting was not enough.
